description: An engineering manager must finalize how to spend the team's 13 available engineering points on technical-debt work for Q3, choosing between webhook deduplication and a billing-query efficiency project, with input from customer support and site reliability.

shared_context.S1: The team has 13 engineering points available for technical-debt work during Q3.
shared_context.S2: Maya makes the final allocation decision and publishes the Q3 engineering plan.
shared_context.S3: The candidate projects are webhook deduplication, which would reduce duplicate event processing, and billing-query efficiency, which would reduce database load.
shared_context.S4: The team's normal planning routine is to review customer-impact and operational-impact evidence before Maya finalizes the allocation.
shared_context.S5: No technical-debt allocation has yet been entered in the Q3 planning document.

PF1.text: During a customer escalation this week, Leo confirmed that 11 enterprise accounts have reproduced duplicate webhook deliveries and that the smallest complete remediation is estimated at exactly 5 engineering points; he has not added the confirmed account count to the planning document yet.

PF2.text: While reviewing the latest cloud database invoice and query traces, Nina confirmed that billing-query efficiency needs exactly 8 engineering points to remove the inefficient query path and avoid the measured peak-load cost; she has not filed the cost analysis in the planning system yet.

acceptance_conditions: Exactly 5 engineering points must be allocated to webhook deduplication.
Exactly 8 engineering points must be allocated to billing-query efficiency.
The published technical-debt allocation must total exactly 13 points.
A webhook-deduplication implementation commitment must be recorded.
A billing-query-efficiency implementation commitment must be recorded.
The customer-impact evidence must be cited as justification for the webhook allocation.

content_checks.C4: any('webhook deduplication' in c['detail'] or (c['target'] == 'Leo' and 'webhook' in c['detail']) or ('Q3 planning document' in c['target'] and 'webhook' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: any('billing-query efficiency' in c['detail'] or (c['target'] == 'Nina' and 'billing-query' in c['detail']) or (('planning system' in c['target'] or 'Q3 planning document' in c['target']) and 'billing-query' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The confirmed 11-account impact and exactly 5-point remediation estimate change the webhook allocation from an unspecified planning choice to exactly 5 points and require a webhook-deduplication commitment.
The measured database cost and exactly 8-point estimate change the billing-query allocation to exactly 8 points and require a billing-query-efficiency commitment.
